args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: service is healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0 (no change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production).
3. **Verified** the rollback: service is healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the v2.3.1 health check failures and the rollback action. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.
